claim: By default an organization can have at most 10 accounts; the quota is adjustable through the Service Quotas console, and only the management account can submit the increase request.
question: What is the default maximum number of accounts in an organization, and who can request an increase?

qualifiers.condition: newly created accounts and organizations might experience a quota below the default

note: d008. Source contradicts the FRESHNESS expectation of a 10,000 default: the current quota page gives 10 as the default maximum. Not the old 5,000 / 10,000 figures.
